data.source_title: Quick Safety 52: Advancing Safety with Closed-loop Communication of Test Results
data.source_setting: Official Joint Commission safety guidance for accredited organizations
data.quantity: Recommended closed-loop test result communication components
data.value: Named responsible clinician; verbal notification and positive receipt for life-threatening findings; timed escalation/back-up; patient-facing contextual explanation and support
data.source_evidence_basis: Joint Commission Quick Safety recommends backup handoffs, consistent assigned follow-up, confirmation of receipt, timed escalation and avoiding portal-only notification.
data.limitations: Informational guidance, not a standard or controlled evaluation; recommendations need local workflow and clinical urgency definitions.
data.inferred_scenario_use: Define status transitions: pending -> received -> acknowledged -> interpreted -> patient/provider informed -> action complete; escalate unacknowledged results.
